limitations: Strictly convex summands only; no uniform quantitative modulus, no theorem for arbitrary Bochner fibers, no independent mathematical validation, and residual risk of an equivalent unpublished/unindexed classification.
scientific_integrity: The structural lemma and the complete necessity/sufficiency argument are analytic; the local Steinhaus equivalence and the real L1 theorem are attributed to existing literature. The atomless complex L1 case follows from stronger 2026 work and is not asserted as original in isolation.
title: Sharp Steinhaus criterion for \(\ell_1\)-sums of strictly convex spaces
